concept: A premium, high-stakes esports arena designed for mobile web. It blends heavy dark mode with intense neon accents (Cyan & Purple) to evoke adrenaline and competitive gaming. The UI avoids flat boring SaaS looks by using neon glows, 1px bright borders, and glassmorphism for a true 'gamer' feel.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#05050A] pb-24 relative overflow-x-hidden

components.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto h-20 bg-[#05050A]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-[#00E5FF]/20 flex justify-around items-center px-2 z-50

cards.tournament: relative overflow-hidden bg-[#0F0F1A] border border-[#00E5FF]/20 rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#00E5FF]/60 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.15)]
cards.wallet: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0F0F1A] to-[#1A1A2E] border border-[#9D00FF]/30 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(157,0,255,0.1)]

buttons.primary: w-full py-4 bg-[#00E5FF] text-[#05050A] font-black uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl hover:bg-white hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300 flex justify-center items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: w-full py-4 bg-transparent border border-[#00E5FF] text-[#00E5FF] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl hover:bg-[#00E5FF]/10 transition-all flex justify-center items-center gap-2
buttons.danger: w-full py-4 bg-[#FF0055]/10 border border-[#FF0055] text-[#FF0055] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl hover:bg-[#FF0055]/20

tags.live: bg-[#FF0055] text-white text-xs font-black px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(255,0,85,0.5)]
tags.game_mode: bg-white/10 text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase backdrop-blur-md

components.inputs: bg-[#1A1A2E] border border-white/10 text-white placeholder-white/40 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] transition-all w-full

motion_and_interactions.page_transition: opacity-0 translate-y-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500

hero_background.description: A glowing neon game controller icon floating. Use for home screen hero banner or login background.

tournament_header.description: Dark room with neon signs, representing the arena stage.

wallet_bg.description: Purple and pink abstract light. Use as a subtle background pattern for the Wallet balance card with low opacity.

promo_gamer.description: Person playing a mobile game on a handheld device. Use for Referral or Match History empty states.

icons.style: stroke-width: 2, sharp edges preferred. Use neon colors for active states.

testing.requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, tournament cards) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='join-tournament-button', data-testid='wallet-deposit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app view mimicking a native app experience using Tailwind CSS 'max-w-md mx-auto' container for the main user app.
Implement the 5 tabs (Home, Tournaments, Wallet, Leaderboard, Profile) as a sticky bottom navigation.
For the Admin panel, break out of the mobile constraint (use full width desktop layout) to present data-dense tables using the 'Control Room' grid.
Strictly adhere to the dark neon theme. Do not use pure white backgrounds anywhere.
Ensure glassmorphism overlays (backdrop-blur) are used on floating elements like navigation and modals.
Incorporate Framer Motion for smooth tab transitions and button press effects.
All buttons and clickable cards MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use standard Shadcn components but heavily customize them with the provided neon borders, deep backgrounds, and specific fonts.
Install Google Fonts 'Unbounded' and 'Manrope' via next/font or standard import.
